about: Demo extraction register: what the document extraction reads from each demo file, keyed by file content (sha256). Stands in for the AI so the live demo is repeatable; any other file goes to the real AI extraction. Readings marked illustrative are demo assumptions, to be confirmed on site.

files.note: Energy certificate: confirms the bill, building age and area. Says nothing about the radiators.
Clear radiator photo: panel type and pipe layout are readable; the size is estimated (no scale in the photo). One photo says nothing about the rest of the heating system.

radiator_type.evidence: Profiled front panel with a convector grille on top: two-panel radiator (type 22)

pipe_system.evidence: Separate flow and return pipes rise from the floor to the valve and the lower connection

radiator_size_mm.evidence: No scale in the photo: about 600 mm high, panel continues beyond the frame; 1,400 mm wide assumed (illustrative, confirm on site)

files.note: Unclear photo: a bathroom towel radiator on a valve multi-block. Neither the pipe layout nor the type of the panel radiators can be read, so nothing is added.
